actions.action: Bind confirmation to the explicitly selected slot
actions.mechanism: Stable slot identity prevents refreshes or list reordering from changing what the person confirms.
actions.implementation: Store the selected slot ID and displayed booking details. Submit that ID only; require renewed review if material details change.
actions.check: Reorder slots and change their details during review; verify no request books a replacement or materially changed appointment without review.
actions.risk: Matching slots by display position defeats this protection.

actions.action: Keep review controls stationary during capacity updates
actions.mechanism: A persistent review panel preserves focus and pointer targets while availability changes around it.
actions.implementation: Keep the selected slot and confirmation control mounted in normal document flow. Update status without moving controls or automatically switching selection.
actions.check: Refresh capacity repeatedly with keyboard focus and pointer over confirmation; verify focus, target position, and selected identity remain unchanged.
actions.risk: Dynamic messages can move controls unless layout space is reserved.

actions.action: Explain availability changes without creating urgency
actions.mechanism: Explicit, non-expiring status distinguishes selection from reservation without countdowns or promises.
actions.implementation: Show “Selected, not reserved; availability may change.” Announce selected-slot availability transitions politely, suppress duplicate announcements, and keep unavailable status visible.
actions.check: Simulate repeated identical updates followed by unavailability; verify one transition announcement, persistent text, and no automatic dismissal or forced response.
actions.risk: Announcing every five-second refresh can overwhelm assistive technology.

actions.mechanism: Keeping the unavailable choice visible preserves context while alternatives respect the person's existing requirements.
actions.implementation: Retain workshop, week, filters, and accessibility preferences after rejection. Offer matching alternatives without preselecting one; require explicit selection and confirmation.
actions.check: Reject a confirmation and verify preferences remain intact, alternatives meet active filters, and no replacement booking request occurs automatically.
actions.risk: Silently relaxing filters can suggest unsuitable appointments.

actions.action: Separate unavailable responses from uncertain outcomes
actions.mechanism: Distinct pending, rejected, successful, and unknown states prevent premature recovery or accidental duplicate submissions.
actions.implementation: Permit one confirmation request at a time. Preserve review data on rejection; on timeout, show uncertainty and use existing booking-status facilities if available.
actions.check: Test rejection, delayed success, repeated activation, and lost responses; verify no automatic resubmission or unsupported success claim.
actions.risk: Without existing reconciliation facilities, an uncertain outcome may need support.

actions.action: Provide a narrow-screen keyboard slot list
actions.mechanism: A chronological list avoids relying on a seven-column grid, dragging, or precise pointer movement.
actions.implementation: At 320 pixels, show day headings and native slot buttons in one column. Include date, time, and availability in accessible names; preserve logical focus order.
actions.check: Complete selection, review, rejection recovery, and confirmation using only a keyboard at 320 pixels without horizontal page scrolling.
actions.risk: Duplicate hidden layouts can create duplicate focus stops.

actions.action: Preserve review state without an interaction deadline
actions.mechanism: Unlimited interface review time avoids adding motor-speed pressure, although capacity remains unreserved.
actions.implementation: Do not expire selection, reset preferences after inactivity, or add timed retry prompts. If availability returns, update status without automatically confirming.
actions.check: Pause through multiple refresh cycles and resume; verify review state survives, no booking was attempted, and confirmation still uses current endpoint results.
actions.risk: Persistent selection must never imply persistent availability.

actions.action: Measure race-condition recovery independently of speed
actions.mechanism: Controlled rejection scenarios assess accessible recovery rather than rewarding participants who reach confirmation fastest.
actions.implementation: In tests, return unavailability on the first confirmation regardless of elapsed time. Measure wrong-slot bookings, preference loss, failure comprehension, and eventual recovery without deadlines.
actions.check: Run identical scenarios with deliberately delayed input; require zero silent substitutions and preference loss, and report recovery outcomes separately from timing.
actions.risk: Controlled tests do not establish production rejection frequency.
